segments.name: Spain
segments.description: Runs online casino games and online sports betting for players in Spain under the Codere brand.
segments.evidence: The Spain segment consists of revenue generated by CDON.

segments.name: Mexico
segments.description: Offers online casino gaming and online sports betting to players in Mexico through the AenP arrangement.
segments.evidence: The Mexico segment consists of revenue generated by the AenP pursuant to the AenP Agreement.

segments.name: Other Operations
segments.description: Gathers the online casino and sports betting business in Colombia, Panama and Argentina for local players.
segments.evidence: The Other Operations segment consists of revenue generated by Codere Online Colombia S.A.S., Operating Management Services Panama S.A., Codere Online Argentina, S.A. and Codere Online Argentina S.A. Union Transitoria (collectively, "Other Operations").

segments.name: Supporting Entities
segments.description: Provides marketing, management and other support services to the group's operating entities; most revenue is eliminated on consolidation.
segments.evidence: The Supporting Entities segment consists of revenue generated by Codere Israel Marketing Support Services LTD, Codere Online Luxembourg S.A., Codere Online U.S. Corp., and Servicios de Juego Online S.A.U (collectively, the "Supporting Entities").

revenueModel.text: Players pay wagers on online casino games and sports bets; the company keeps a margin on bets and a share of gaming revenue.
revenueModel.evidence: Codere Online earns revenue primarily through online casino and online sports betting.
